name: motion-native
description: Premation native core: test + bench dependencies and zlib (engine_core's portable zips) by default; the `engine` feature adds Dawn for premation-engine (C1, docs/VIEWPORT_ROUTE.md).

engine.description: premation-engine: E3 text + vector (Skia CPU raster built with clang-cl through native/vcpkg-overlays/skia, its PNG / JPEG / WebP codecs on macOS and Linux for still footage, FreeType + woff2 fonts, HarfBuzz shaping, SheenBidi UAX #9, fontconfig for Linux system fonts) + OpenColorIO (D3 colour management) +ffmpeg (E1 decode: avcodec/avformat/swscale, dav1d, libvpx for VP9 alpha, zlib for the PNG / APNG / EXR decoders; hwaccels d3d11va/d3d12va/dxva2 on Windows, videotoolbox on macOS, nvdec where nvcodec is offered, vulkan on Linux) + miniaudio (E2 audio output: header-only; WASAPI / CoreAudio / ALSA-PulseAudio) + Dawn (native WebGPU) with only the backend each OS ships — D3D12 / Metal / Vulkan + ONNX Runtime (CPU; the object-matte job's SAM, run in a child engine process). Enable with VCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=engine (the *-engine presets).
